scope: Generic English thing/things mapped to kitu/vitu without concrete-vs-abstract context

observed_case.source: oh. it must be an American thing?
observed_case.context: The preceding exchange explains what a valedictorian is.

evidence.publisher: National African Language Resource Center, University of Wisconsin-Madison
evidence.finding_paraphrase: The grammar explicitly distinguishes an object referred to by kitu/vitu from an abstract matter referred to by jambo/mambo.
evidence.use: Factual verification only; no course passage imported as a pack mapping.

evidence.finding_paraphrase: Jambo covers matter, thing, affair. This supports preserving the sense distinction rather than treating every English thing as an object.

decision.not_a_global_claim: Kitu may have extended uses; these sources do not qualify this particular abstract-custom face. No universal blacklist or replacement with jambo is introduced.
decision.plural_reason: Same lexeme and primary plural relation; no independently observed plural failure is claimed.
decision.fallback: The existing provider-backed baseline selected kitu in the same case. Revision3 data withholding alone does not alter or certify that fallback.
